analysis.purpose: The C# cross-file resolver: turns the cross-file references an extractor recorded — imports, calls, inheritance and interface implementation — into real edges by looking every target up in the global symbol table.
responsibilities: Resolve import specifiers to the symbols they actually name
Link a caller to the imported symbol it invokes
Resolve inheritance and interface implementation across files into edges

businessRules.rule: Every target is resolved through the global symbol table rather than matched by name.
businessRules.rationale: A name-matched edge would be a guess presented as a fact.

businessRules.rule: A reference that does not resolve is dropped and counted, never guessed.
businessRules.rationale: A missing edge is honest; a wrong one is not.

edges.rationale: This file is the C# resolver.
